editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: AvaTrade is a legitimate multi-regulated broker operating since 2006 with 9 regulatory licences across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Africa. It scores 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026 — strong on platform choice and educational resources, weaker on spread costs and withdrawal speed. MT4, MT5, and proprietary platforms are all available alongside copy trading via AvaSocial. Fixed spreads of 0.9 pips on EUR/USD are predictable but permanently wider than ECN brokers. The 71% retail loss rate is moderate by industry standards. AvaTrade works for the intermediate trader who wants everything in one place — MT4, copy trading, vanilla options, and solid education — without needing the absolute tightest execution.
